text:
maria_support: Hey team — Support would like UserReplay full-session access for a couple of customer tickets (IDs #2342, #2347). Are there any redaction/privacy concerns we should handle before granting? cc @sam_security @alisha_privacy
kevin_eng: what exact data do we need? session replay + console logs or network payloads?
maria_support: mainly session replay + console logs. Don't need request bodies. Just want to see UI steps and JS errors.
sam_security: short answer: need to limit to session visuals + console, redact input fields and network bodies. Also confirm consent scope (GDPR cookie banner) and retention policy.
alisha_privacy: +1. Also need delete/retention policy — we prefer 30d for support access. Any PII in sessions? if users type names/emails in forms they could be captured.
maria_support: understood. Is there a config to auto-mask input fields?
kevin_eng: yes. In UserReplay we can set CSS selectors to mask inputs and disable recording of XHR bodies. Example config:
```json
{
  "maskInputs": true,
  "maskedSelectors": ["input[type=text]", "input[type=email]"],
  "captureNetwork": false
}
```
sam_security: Also ensure access via Okta group so we can audit. We should create an 'support-userreplay' group with just 3 members.
sara_legal: Need to confirm terms: vendor data processing addendum + SCC if EU customers. If the customers are EU-based, we must not export full sessions outside EU without legal sign-off.
maria_support: Are we good to proceed with an approval ticket? I'll open one once we have the config and group details.
sam_security: Approve conditionally — create ticket with: list of sessions, scopes, mask config, retention days, Okta group, and a note that legal signed off if EU data. Then we'll do a 24h approval window.
alisha_privacy: Also log in our privacy register (sheet link) and note opt-in vs. opt-out status for affected customers.
maria_support: I'll create the ticket and add the config + the 3 member list. Thanks!
deploy-bot: Ticket created: https://tickets.internal/INC-8421 — status: awaiting-security-review :white_check_mark:
kevin_eng: FYI we should add a runtime toggle to disable replay capture for flagged enterprise customers.
maria_support: noted, thanks all :bow:
